title: MEMORY
description: Something the system learned that is not recoverable from any file. A map of the code can be rebuilt by re-reading the code; 'we tried this and it failed because X' cannot. Lose it and it is gone, which is why every field here exists.

claim.description: One fact, stated plainly. A claim holding three facts cannot be contradicted, expired or verified independently.

confidence.description: observed: seen directly, with evidence. inferred: concluded from things we observed. unverified: asserted, not yet checked - and never to be served as though it were observed.

source.description: Artifact digest, ledger entry, or a named person. A memory that cannot say where it came from cannot be re-checked when it is doubted.

owner.description: Who answers for this being true.

learnedAt.description: When we came to believe it. Transaction time - half of the bitemporal pair.

trueFrom.description: When the fact itself started being true. Valid time. Diverges from learnedAt constantly, and collapsing the two makes 'which of these contradicting memories is current' unanswerable.

trueUntil.description: When it stopped being true, if it has. Set this rather than deleting: a fact that used to be true is the reason an old decision looked right.

lastVerified.description: When someone last confirmed it still holds. Distinct from learnedAt, and the field that makes staleness detectable at all - staleness is a provenance problem, not a schedule problem.

verifyEvery.description: How long before it needs re-checking, e.g. 90d. Absent means it does not decay.

scope.description: What this is about - paths, subsystems, subjects. A memory that applies everywhere is recalled everywhere and discriminates nowhere.

dataClass.description: Governs who and what may retrieve it.

supersedes.description: Digest of the memory this replaces. Contradiction is resolved by superseding, never by silent overwrite.

quarantined.description: Came from somewhere untrusted - retrieved content, an unreviewed proposal. Stored but never served as fact until reviewed. This is the ASI06 memory-poisoning boundary.

promotedTo.description: Where this became durable, if it did. A memory recalled repeatedly should stop being a memory and become a constraint, an orientation doc, or a register finding.
